name: Southwest Rapid Rewards Priority Credit Card

localized_names.en: Southwest Rapid Rewards Priority Credit Card

apr.notes: Variable APRs; purchase APR 19.24% to 27.74%. Cash advance APR 28.49%. Penalty APR up to 29.99%.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees. Terms page: Foreign - None.

base_rate.description: Earn 1 point for each dollar spent on all other purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Points redeemed through the Rapid Rewards program for Southwest Airlines flights and other rewards. Your points don't expire, a benefit of the Rapid Rewards program.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 60,000 bonus points after you spend $2,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening.

benefits.title: First Checked Bag Free
benefits.description: Cardmembers and up to 8 additional passengers in the same reservation can check their bag at no additional cost. Save up to $90 round trip ($45 per bag per trip).

benefits.title: Complimentary Preferred Seat at Booking
benefits.description: Select a Preferred seat at booking, at no additional charge, when available.

benefits.title: Extra Legroom Seat Upgrade
benefits.description: Enjoy unlimited upgrades to an Extra Legroom seat within 48 hours prior to departure, at no additional charge, when available.

benefits.title: Group 5 Boarding Benefit
benefits.description: Cardmembers and up to 8 additional passengers in the same reservation will board with Group 5 giving them earlier access to overhead bins.

benefits.title: 7,500 Anniversary Points Each Year
benefits.description: Receive 7,500 bonus points each year on your Cardmember anniversary.

benefits.title: 10,000 Companion Pass Qualifying Points Boost
benefits.description: Receive 10,000 Companion Pass qualifying points boost each year.

benefits.title: Tier Qualifying Points Toward A-List Status
benefits.description: Earn 2,500 tier qualifying points (TQPs) toward A-List status for every $5,000 spent in purchases annually.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: You will pay no foreign transaction fees when you use your card for purchases made outside the United States.

benefits.title: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Provides reimbursement up to $3,000 per covered traveler for the cost to repair or replace checked or carry-on baggage that is lost, damaged or stolen during a covered trip.

benefits.title: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimburses you up to $100 a day for up to 3 days for essential purchases like toiletries and clothing when baggage is delayed over 6 hours.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends the time period of the manufacturer's U.S. warranty by an additional year, on eligible warranties of three years or less, up to four years from the date of purchase.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers your eligible new purchases for 120 days from the date of purchase against damage or theft up to $500 per item.

travel_perks.free_checked_bags: First checked bag free for cardmember and up to 8 additional passengers on same reservation
